_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: score band is Disbelief, momentum/funding ~50, and diverging top-analog factors give no clean UP or DOWN breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase/direction (flow data only)
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays near flat and fear_greed holds 55-62 with momentum still around 50
next_move.invalidated_if: btc_momentum_30d leaves 40-60 and fear_greed exits 55-62 (above 70 or below 47), especially if funding lifts or gold/VIX spike on a downside break
